Dignitas (known as Team Dignitas prior to October 30, 2018) is an American esports organization known for housing Counter-Strike lineups since the early years of the game. It has housed numerous lineups in all three mainstream Counter-Strike games. Prior to the rebrand in late 2018, the organization was founded in the United Kingdom by Michael "ODEE" O'Dell.
